first_token_rule: pinned recipient initial logits consumed exactly once by native sampler; no forward at t0

comparison_rules.arithmetic: FP32 source vectors promoted to FP64; FP64 differences and sums; preserve both repeats; no epsilon zero declarations
comparison_rules.margin_certificate: observed EMPTY top1 margin m > 2*||z_S-z_EMPTY||_infinity is sufficient at that observed same-prefix position only; converse false
comparison_rules.no_drift_hiding: preserve unequal repeated FP32 logits even when endpoint equal
comparison_rules.third_candidates: report true argmax and r/u ranks over complete vocabulary
comparison_rules.vector_residual: full vocabulary FP64 vector follows same four-cell contrast

frozen_mixtures_input_ids_and_endpoints: PLAN.json immutable full 56-cell and 168-slot bodies; no donor resampling
integration_policy: amend only not-yet-started coordinates prospectively; preserve all attempts; no retry
